title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Blackburn Permanent Office-based

Are you an experienced Accounts Assistant looking for your next opportunity within a successful and growing business?

We are working with an established Lancashire-based business that has built a strong reputation within its specialist industry. Due to continued growth and a busy finance function, they are now looking to appoint an Accounts Assistant to join their team and take responsibility for a varied range of transactional finance duties.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a busy accounts environment, is confident handling high volumes of financial transactions and takes pride in keeping accounts accurate and up to date.

The Role

Working as part of the finance team, you will play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the accounts function, with a particular focus on purchase and sales ledger.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing a high volume of purchase and sales ledger transactions, approximately 1,800 per month
- Processing supplier invoices accurately and efficiently
- Matching invoices against purchase orders and delivery documentation
- Raising and processing sales invoices
- Maintaining accurate supplier and customer account records
- Assisting with supplier and customer account reconciliations
- Processing payments and supporting payment runs
- Investigating and resolving invoice, payment and account queries
- Liaising with suppliers and customers regarding outstanding queries and balances
- Ensuring financial information is accurately recorded and kept up to date
- Supporting month-end processes and wider finance duties
- Working closely with colleagues across the business to resolve discrepancies and ensure financial information is accurate

About You

We are looking for someone with previous experience within an accounts or finance position who is confident working with transactional finance and managing a busy workload.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant, finance, purchase ledger or sales ledger role
- A good understanding of transactional accounting processes
- Experience processing a high volume of invoices and financial transactions
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Strong organisational and time-management skills
- Good communication skills, both written and verbal
- Confidence dealing with suppliers, customers and internal colleagues
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- Experience using Sage 200 would be beneficial

Most importantly, you will be reliable, organised and proactive, with a genuine interest in accounts and a willingness to become a valued member of a busy finance team.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £30,000
- 25 days annual leave + bank holidays
- Company pension
- Permanent, full-time position
- Office-based working environment
- Opportunity to join an established and growing Lancashire business
- Supportive finance team
- Excellent opportunity to develop your accounts experience

If you are looking for a varied Accounts Assistant position where you can build on your transactional finance experience and become an important part of an established finance team, we would love to hear from you.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Looking for a customer service role where you can make a real difference and turn your experience into a permanent opportunity?
We're looking for a Customer Service Advisor to join a busy team based in Blackburn. This is a full-time temporary role with an immediate start and the opportunity to go permanent, paying 13.45 per hour.
With a variety of shifts available, this is a great opportunity for someone with previous call handling or customer service experience who enjoys helping people, resolving queries and making sure customers receive the support they need.
What will you be doing Customer Service Advisor?
- Answering incoming calls and responding to customer enquiries.
- Managing customer queries and helping to resolve issues efficiently.
- Providing clear information, guidance and reassurance to customers.
- Listening carefully to understand each customer's needs and concerns.
- Delivering a professional and helpful customer service experience.
- Recording relevant information accurately and keeping customer records up to date.
- Escalating incidents or more complex queries to the appropriate team when needed.

What's in it for you?
- 13.45 per hour
- Full-time hours averaging 37.5 hours per week on a planned rota.

- Immediate start

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Are you a great listener who can stay calm under pressure and help people get the support they need?
We're looking for a Customer Service Advisor or a Call Handler to join a busy out-of-hours helpdesk team in Blackburn. With the busy season approaching, the team is expanding to support an increase in calls from tenants reporting maintenance and repairs requests.
Paying 13.45 per hour, this is a temporary position for 12 weeks working in the evenings during the week and weekends, with the opportunity to go permanent. You'll receive training on the company's established processes and systems, so you'll understand how to assess requests, record information accurately and ensure each issue reaches the right team.
If you have at least 1 year of call centre or customer service experience and enjoy helping people find solutions, this could be a great opportunity for you!
What will you be doing as a Customer Service Advisor / Call Handler?
- Answering a high volume of calls from tenants reporting maintenance and repairs requests
- Listening carefully to understand the problem and asking the right questions to establish the root cause
- Following a structured questionnaire to gather all the necessary information about each issue
- Assessing and triaging requests as emergency, urgent or non-emergency
- Recording information accurately using ticketing systems, drop-down menus and set processes
- Passing completed requests to the appropriate team, who will arrange the necessary repairs or fixes
- Providing reassurance and clear information to tenants, including those who may be vulnerable or distressed
- Recognising when an issue needs further attention and escalating it in line with the relevant procedures

What's in it for you?
- 13.45 per hour
- Opportunity to secure a longer-term position after the initial 12 weeks.
- Established training programme
- 2 paid 10-minute breaks during your shift.
- Unpaid 30-minute lunch break.
- Immediate start
- Valuable experience - develop your call handling, problem-solving and customer service skills in a fast-paced environment

Why would you join this company?
You'll be joining an established team providing an important out-of-hours service, helping tenants report property issues and ensuring their concerns are recorded, prioritised and passed to the right people for action.
Accuracy is key, as the information you gather helps the repairs team understand the problem and arrange the appropriate fix. You'll be supported by an established training process, giving you the knowledge and guidance needed to learn the systems and carry out the role effectively.
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys helping people, working as part of a team and making a practical difference to the customer experience.
What we're looking for
What's essential:
- At least 1 year's call centre customer service experience.
- Strong listening skills and the ability to ask relevant questions to understand a customer's issue.
- An empathetic approach and good emotional intelligence, particularly when speaking to vulnerable or distressed customers.
- Clear communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- Excellent attention to detail, ensuring information is recorded accurately and all required questions are answered.
- The ability to follow set procedures and categorise requests correctly.
- The ability to manage a high volume of calls, moving efficiently from one conversation to the next while maintaining good customer service.

What's helpful but not essential:
- Experience in property maintenance, housing, repairs or facilities management.
- Experience using ticketing systems, CRM databases or structured call-handling questionnaires.
- Experience assessing and prioritising customer requests or incidents.

The Essentials
Salary: 13.45 per hour
Hours: Weekday evenings, 5:00 pm-10:00 pm, and weekend shifts, 8:00 am-5:00 pm. Shifts will depend on the rota and service requirements.
Breaks: Two paid 10-minute breaks and one unpaid 30-minute lunch break per shift.
Location: Blackburn
Job type: Temporary for 12 weeks, with the opportunity to go permanent.
Start date: Immediate

To Apply
If you're an experienced call centre professional looking for an immediate start, structured training and the opportunity to secure a permanent position, we'd LOVE to hear from you!
Send your CV today to be considered for this opportunity.

title: Front of House & Admissions Coordinator (AP)
description:
Job Title: Front of House & Pupil Referrals Coordinator

Location: Accrington, Lancashire (Hyndburn)

Contract Type: Full-Time, Temporary-to-Permanent

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM (Term-time + inset days, or full-year contract negotiable)

Salary: Up to 35,000 per annum upon permanent appointment (paid as an equivalent competitive daily/hourly rate during the initial temp-to-perm trial)

About the Role & Setting

Our specialist Alternative Provision (AP) in Accrington supports secondary and upper-primary learners facing social, emotional, and mental health (SEMH) challenges who require a positive, nurturing pathway outside mainstream school.

We are seeking a vibrant, highly engaging, and organised Front of House & Referrals Coordinator to become the welcoming face and operational heartbeat of our school. In an AP environment, front of house is far more than standard reception work-it is the very first touchpoint for vulnerable young people arriving in the morning, anxious parents seeking reassurance, and visiting multi-agency professionals.

Key Responsibilities
Front of House & Engagement
- Morning Greeting & First Impressions: Create a warm, grounded, and de-escalating welcome for students arriving at school, helping set a calm tone for the day.
- Visitor & Visitor Safeguarding: Manage reception, visitor sign-ins, ID checks, and Single Central Record (SCR) visitor protocols in line with Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE).
- Relationship Building: Act as the first point of contact for parents and carers, establishing trust, de-escalating frustrations, and communicating with empathy and clear boundaries.

Admissions & Referrals Management
- Referral Pipeline: Coordinate inbound pupil referrals received from local authorities (Lancashire County Council), commissioning partner secondary schools, and academy trusts.
- Induction & Transition Coordination: Collate pupil background paperwork, EHCP documentation, risk assessments, and previous school files to prepare admissions packs.
- Multi-Agency Liaison: Act as the main administrative liaison between SENCOs, social workers, youth offending teams, and local authority inclusion caseworkers.
- Data & Attendance: Input and track attendance data and referral status using school management information systems (e.g., CPOMS, SIMS, or Arbor).

What We Are Looking For
- Personality & Energy: An outgoing, energetic, and resilient personality with exceptional interpersonal skills-you naturally connect with people from all walks of life.
- Engagement & De-escalation: Natural confidence, emotional intelligence, and calm composure when dealing with distressed, deregulated, or anxious pupils and parents.
- Administrative Rigour: Strong organisational and IT capabilities to handle pupil admissions files, confidentiality (GDPR), and multi-agency referral documentation.
- Background: Experience in school administration, pupil referral units (PRU), medical/care front of house, hospitality management, customer relations, or youth liaison is highly welcomed.
- Safeguarding: Commitment to the highest standards of child protection (an Enhanced DBS check on the Update Service will be required prior to start).

Package & Progression
- Permanent Salary: Up to 35,000 per annum (dependent on experience) upon successful completion of the temp-to-perm transition period.
- Direct Route to Permanent: A structured 12-week agency transition offering immediate start flexibility with guaranteed permanent stability once established.
- Supportive Culture: Collaborative senior leadership team, continuous professional development (including de-escalation/Team-Teach and advanced safeguarding training), and free on-site parking in Accrington.
